| You : A resourceful marketer ready for a challenge and to help us take the Linktree brand to the next phase of our growth. You'll love variety in your days and have previous experience in tech / SaaS start-ups so you understand our customers and how your day can go from planned to out the window in minutes. Us : Linktree, an Australian tech startup that has gone global. In 2020 we went from 3 to 10 million accounts and 15 to 60 staff. In 2021, our growth is projected to be higher. We currently average around 30,000 new account signups per day. Everyday. Are we a match? Let's discuss further. Description : Linktree is in an exciting phase of growth with a lot of product features and exciting things planned. Our marketing team is small but growing, so we've got a lot to do and a lot of processes to put in place while getting campaigns out at the same time. We're looking for a Marketing Coordinator to take some of the load off our Marketing Manager Maddy who is spinning a lot of plates at the moment. For those looking for a mentor that is generous with their time, extremely hardworking and hands on while at the same time, super ready for after work drinks and laughs, Maddy is your dream. Note if you don't like competitive trivia players, Maddy is your nightmare) You will help Maddy create some structure when it comes to our campaign management, reporting, and workflows. You'll work closely with the other areas of our marketing team and the wider business. One day you might take a brief from the Product team on an upcoming feature release, the next day you'll brainstorm content ideas with our social team and that afternoon, you'll have a WIP with our PR agency. Other tasks will include but not be limited to : management of our blog and its content, adhoc PR, running email campaigns, diving deep into analytics and providing insights to the wider team. It's important to know that right now, we're not a highly structured team or company. We are working on that. So if your middle name is ambiguity or controlled-chaos, you will like it here. Specifically we're looking for someone who : Has 2-3 years prior marketing experience, preferably in a SaaS / tech company Has experience marketing consumer tech brands across a wide range of digital channels and formats (video, email, content, social, mobile etc) Has experience with marketing automation platforms like Braze or Hubspot Can draft compelling copy for blogs, social, events, announcement and, emails Can provide the design team with airtight briefs for marketing collateral Can set up campaign tracking & reporting Has experience inputting content into a CMS (Contentful & Wordpress is a bonus) Has great people skills when managing internal stakeholders and external partners to keep cross-functional projects on track Can be a brand champion for Linktree, ensuring all our owned assets are consistent and up to date Can use Google Analytics and / or Heap to dig into data and provide insights and turn them into compelling stories or meaningful analysis Where is this role-based : Our Head Office and most of our Marketing team is currently based in Melbourne so we'd like this person to be in Melbourne for easy collaboration. We offer great work flexibility with a lot of freedom to how many days you work from home or in the office. What is your company culture like? While every company will say their culture is amazing, we think ours really is. Linktree's company culture and values are based around collaboration, diversity, inclusion, and flexibility. Those are all nice words but to give you some more specific examples : We are a family-friendly and flexible work environment with our team with a number of our team working hours around their school and home commitments. We have several diversity and inclusion initiatives underway, including a D&I council, training for all staff on neurodiversity and the incorporation of a transgender inclusion policy. Our team is diverse across age, gender, and race and we are very proud of that. Due to COVID we are all remote but even when COVID is behind us, we will be a mixed remote and in-office company. With our team already spread across Australia, USA, Ireland and Brazil, we will always be some form of remote in our ways of working. We prioritise our team's mental health, with all employees have free access to https : / / www.smilingmind.com.au / & https : / / uprise. co / , including 1 : 1 coaching sessions from qualified psychologists or counselors. The Linktree story The Linktree journey begins in 2016 when co-founders Alex, Anthony and Nick were running a digital agency and using Instagram to make announcements about the artists they managed. Created as a side hustle to solve a simple problem, Linktree has well outgrown its roots, with over 10 million users worldwide, 30,000 new signups every day, and over 120 million unique views per month. Paired with rapid growth, Linktree has recently garnered much attention in the tech world, earning 4th place on Fast Company's "10 most innovative social media companies of 2020" . The Linktree audience is broad, spanning publications, artists, celebrities, fashion and beauty influencers, YouTube stars, sports teams and household brands, right the way through to individuals with a side hustle and micro-influencers. Linktree subscribers include Alicia Keys, Selena Gomez, Pharrell, Jamie Oliver, Vice, Red Bull, Adult Swim, Patreon, Naomi Campbell, Comedy Central, Gordon Ramsay, Billabong and many more!

We set out to use the power of the latest medical research, human-centered design, and data science to create the highly personalized and practical app-based solutions needed to empower patients in taking back control over their conditions and leading the change beyond conventional therapy. We are backed by Atlantic Food Labs (AFL), a leading venture studio and early-stage investor focused on supporting the next generation of health, food & sustainability companies, and are now looking for a senior full-stack software engineer to join us on our mission in our Studio in Berlin or remotely. WHY JOIN US The potential to solve one of the biggest health crises of our generation affecting 1bn+ people globally We are just getting started, so youll have the opportunity to shape the direction of the company from the start and get lots of room for your ideas and freedom to experiment The technical challenge at hand is unique: we are on a mission to use data science to untangle human metabolism and build products to impact human behavior for good An attractive package with base salary and equity potential A high-growth, ambitious startup environment with an exponential learning curve and the possibility to grow in many directions (incl. Tech Lead / CTO) An exceptional team that brings in expertise from building products in the space, leading digital health startups, and strategy consulting with background from medicine, neuroscience to business Backed by Atlantic Food Labs and part of its portfolio and network which includes some of the most inspiring startups in the field such as Clue, Meditopia, Cara Care, or Casper The option to work for our office in Berlin Mitte (with the best rooftop terrace in town) or work fully remote YOUR ROLE We're looking for a talented Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join us on our mission and lead the development of algorithms and our mobile app. This will be the first engineering role and therefore you will be a foundational pillar of the overall venture. You will shape the direction of the company without inheriting any sup-optimal processes or legacy code. Working closely with the founders across medical and product, you will develop and launch the first version of our mobile product with the goal of making a direct impact on our early users lives and metabolic health. This requires you to enjoy both thinking about the big picture and taking decisions on our technology as well as hands-on building our first product. YOUR TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES Product You will be actively involved in the end-to-end product development cycle, helping to shape the solution we are building. Architecture & Design You will build our MVP from scratch and lead all development efforts necessary, including selecting the tech stack to use, designing the architecture of the initial end-to-end data analytics workflow as well as building the code base for it Together with Product, you will set up all required development processes considering regulatory requirements (e.g., DSGVO, MDR) Development As the first engineering role, you will lead the overall software & algorithm development We are looking to build and iterate quickly You are in charge of the entire development process; planning, developing, testing, and shipping the product Team You will play a key role in recruiting and building an exceptional team of software engineers and data scientists WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED A keen interest in building products that truly solve a societal problem and improve the healthcare system and patient's wellbeing As we are building something fundamentally new, you are excited about working under ambiguity and using your creativity to experiment and continuously solve problems A strong hands-on attitude and willingness to take on various tasks inside and outside your field of expertise Several years of high-performance tech environment (ideally start-up) as a Senior Software Engineer University degree from a technical field such as Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Maths or similar Experience working full-stack: Backend - for example; Node.js / Java Frontend - for example; React Native / Flutter Experience with and/or an interest in cloud architectures, end-to-end data analytics pipelines, and AI / ML are a plus
